title: Keep ReceiptClock logical and millisecond timelines from being mixed
description: rust/lichen-link/src/evidence.rs uses one last_ticks value for observe/observe_millis and next_logical, so a LinkLayer caller can mix receive_frame and receive_frame_at in one clock domain. Logical packet counts then become comparable to milliseconds, can induce false regressions, and elapsed_since may return meaningless durations across modes. Make the receipt clock mode explicit/fail closed on mixing or maintain distinct domains, and test both call orders.
